==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
In this world, dragons exist. Most people are unaware of their presence on Earth. Knowledge of dragons is more common on other worlds.

There is an intergalactic police force in charge of protecting dragons. These officers wear black armored uniforms. They possess the ability to communicate with dragons.

I remember a female officer with long green hair. She has a small, white, cybernetic, dragon companion that follows her around. It is her first time visiting Earth.
